newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostic, Biochem in pact.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostic, Biochem in pact.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc on Tuesday said it has signed a letter of intent with BioChem ImmunoSystems Inc, a division of BioChem Pharma Inc, for the distribution of Saliva Diagnostic's rapid HIV tests in parts of Europe, Latin America and Africa.
Financial terms of the agreement were undisclosed.
Further discussions will take place regarding Asian markets and collaborations in the United States, Saliva Diagnostics said in a statement.
